summary: The registrant, Wing Yip Food Holdings Group Ltd, filed a Form 6-K reporting a share consolidation at a 4:1 ratio, effective May 8, 2026, alongside an ADS consolidation effective June 2, 2026. The terms include no change to the ADS-to-ordinary-share ratio; fractional entitlements will be aggregated and sold for cash. The board recommended the consolidation to meet Nasdaq's minimum bid price rule under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) and mitigate delisting risk. As of May 7, 2026, the company had 50,330,928 ordinary shares outstanding. Post-consolidation, approximately 12,582,732 ordinary shares and 589,375 ADSs will be outstanding. Watch for Nasdaq compliance confirmation; no deal or strategic event is involved.
